Name: Screenshot Primary Screen
CustomSubs:
Sub ScreenShotPrimaryScreen(SaveToPath As String)
		' Get the size of the primary screen
		Dim screenSize As Size = Screen.PrimaryScreen.Bounds.Size

		' Create a bitmap of that size
		Using bmp As New Bitmap(screenSize.Width, screenSize.Height)
			' Draw the screen into the bitmap
			Using g As Graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bmp)
				g.CopyFromScreen(0, 0, 0, 0, screenSize)
			End Using

			' Save the bitmap to the provided path
			bmp.Save(SaveToPath, ImageFormat.Png)
		End Using
	End Sub
